title: Brazil Série B 2026 — score correction and data-quality audit

score_repair.method: For each match, use preserved Flashscore common_feed fields DE=home full-time goals and DF=away full-time goals; cross-check DE/DG and DF/DH duplicate fields.
score_repair.individual_match_page_rechecks: The preserved Flashscore feed fields were processed for all records. Individual Flashscore pages were not independently reopened one by one; no scores were guessed.

xg_mapping_repair.method: Align top-level xg.home_xG and xg.away_xG with the full-match Expected goals (xG) entry in the first 'Top stats' section.
xg_mapping_repair.missing_values_policy: Unknown values remain null; no missing value is replaced with 0.

data_quality.raw_team_stats_feed_removed: team_stats.raw_feed omitted; normalized team-level metrics retained.
data_quality.period_metric_scope: Only full-match team_stats.metrics retained; first-half and second-half metric duplicates omitted.

caveats: This is a corrected JSON file, not a Supabase import; the database has not been changed.
Scores are corrected from Flashscore common_feed fields preserved in each source record, not estimates.
Individual Flashscore match pages were not independently reopened one by one.
Half-time scores are preserved as recorded; full-time scores and top-level full-match xG mapping were corrected.
